name: Yohaku Studio
description: A quiet, editorial and geometric portfolio theme for a small graphic, advertising and web design studio taking client work. Cool paper white, light grey and ink, with muted ochre only for printer's crop marks and registration targets. A magazine masthead (a thin dateline with the studio's founding year, disciplines and availability, a large Hedvig Letters Serif wordmark and a ruled menu row) opens every page. The home page sets a short statement on a faint baseline grid, then the selected work as an asymmetric mosaic of project cards with crop marks and numbered figure captions, the packages, the four-stage process in one line, the team and the journal. The footer is a wide "Have a brief? Start a project" band over the studio details. With a filterable Work page (All, Graphic, Advertising, Web; every project shows without JavaScript), six case studies, Services and prices, Process, a Start a project brief form that composes an email (no backend), About, Journal, Newsletter and Contact. The studio details and the packages are synced patterns, edited once. Hedvig Letters Serif over Geist, Geist Mono for figure numbers. WCAG AA colours; no entrance animations.
